questions.e: The MOU binds fiscal authorities and the central bank to coordinated action to address structural inflation, public debt, and FX management, removing historic policy divergence. Option B, C, and D are incorrect fabrications involving foreign exchange privatization, UK gold transfers, and Indian liquidity auctions.
